analysis: The 1024-negative experiment completed successfully but reduced macro validation HR@10 to 0.5188 from the supplied 0.5400 reference, a decline of 0.0212. Category HR@10 was 0.540 Movies_and_TV, 0.585 Industrial_and_Scientific, 0.395 Electronics, and 0.555 CDs_and_Vinyl. Electronics declined from the supplied 0.420 reference to 0.395. Macro HR@20 was 0.6663 versus the supplied 0.6600 reference, so the larger negative pool did not improve the target top-10 metric despite slightly higher top-20 recall. These observations do not establish why performance declined; training curves and completed update counts were not supplied. Retain 256 negatives as the stronger observed reference for future single-model experiments.
code_summary: Trains one independent GRURec per category with seed 42 and unchanged supplied splits. Each network uses 128-dimensional tied item embeddings, a two-layer GRU, gated causal attention over recurrent states, layer normalization, dropout, an output projection, and learned item biases. The experiment changes only shared uniformly sampled negatives from 256 to 1024 in sampled-softmax cross-entropy, preserving duplicate draws, training-window collision masking, and the 2048-position cap. AdamW, scheduling, clipping, validation checkpoint selection, and stopping rules remain unchanged. The generated predictor routes each category to exactly one selected checkpoint and scores exclusively through that network; no ensemble or checkpoint averaging is used.
